description: Source code for the 'WizardCommand' component of the OpenClaw macOS CLI application. It handles command-line argument parsing, error handling, and the orchestration of an interactive 'wizard' process that communicates with a gateway server via WebSocket, managing user prompts and responses.

classes.name: GatewayWizardClient
classes.description: An actor class that manages WebSocket communication with a wizard gateway, handling connection setup, request/response messaging, and handshake protocols.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a WizardCliOptions struct.

methods.name: runWizardCommand
methods.description: Main entry point to run the wizard process based on provided arguments, coordinating connection and interaction with the gateway.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to the gateway endpoint.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request over WebSocket and waits for a response matching a specific method and id.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes the payload of a response frame into a specified Decodable type.

methods.name: waitForConnectChallenge
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a 'connect.challenge' event from the gateway during handshake.
